verdict.rationale: Warp mentions a settings file giving 'programmatic control over settings and easy portability between devices' and open-sources its client code, which are thin, tangential signals toward data portability, but there is no documented feature for exporting full user data (history, Warp Drive workflows, conversations) in an open format for migration/exit. Missing for 10: a documented full data-export tool/format, evidence of exporting conversation/workflow history, and any account-deletion/data-portability guarantee.
